natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation down 6%, directly matching the two inherited memories about onboarding simplification improving completion and activation durably. Promotional pricing (memory_73) is explicitly flagged with renewal risk, which conflicts with the primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, especially under competitive pricing pressure where matching discounts could accelerate a race-to-the-bottom with low-quality signups. Enterprise sales-assist and referral incentives are valuable but don't address the acute onboarding/activation decline this week. I want to verify memory_31 and memory_86 because they are the two most load-bearing memories for this specific action and I have budget to confirm the original effect sizes and populations (SMB vs broader) before committing the single experiment slot this week, since onboarding overlaps with activation messaging (memory_91) and I want to avoid conflating two similar but distinct interventions.
